# US-005: Record the round change log

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to record what changed in each round, so that the client sees how feedback was handled.

## Context

ROUND CHANGE LOG (L169–L193).

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-video-review-012](../srs/video-review-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Round change log |

### AC-001 — Log shown per round

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-012
- **Screen:** video-review

```gherkin

When Video Review opens
Then the Round Change Log shows both lines under Round 2
```
